pageName.schemaComment: sidebar-navigation/defaults stores {version:1,revision,sections}, with each ERP/CRM/Storetools/Connect section's enabled flag and hidden page paths. Without saved choices only ERP is enabled; CRM/Storetools/Connect default to false. Company exceptions use explicit saved flags, never name matching. The prior JSON is backed up under defaults-backup. Authorized admin/manager settings APIs own writes; generic generated mutations must reject this key. These are company presentation choices, intersected with existing plan/role and workflow menus. Direct route/API authorization is unchanged. No DDL. after-sales/service-charge-category stores {version:1,categoryId} for the company's automatically reused Service Charges category. Charge save and service invoice issuance ensure it transactionally; catalogue reads never create it. Service line tax/rate snapshots remain independent of category tax. invoices/defaults and sales/defaults store versioned billing document/table defaults (notes, terms, invoice paymentTermId, pageSize, showSummary). The prior JSON is backed up under defaults-backup; authorized settings APIs own writes. New/reset local drafts adopt defaults; issued bills and existing drafts retain their values. Receipt designs remain under printer/templates. No DDL needed. billing/payment-terms stores versioned named invoice terms ({id,name,days}), with the prior value in payment-terms-backup. Built-in date rules stay in code. Existing Bill.invoicePaymentTerms/dueDate retain the issued text/date snapshot. printer/templates JSON supports receipt paperSize A4/A5/Letter, paged PDF output and independently positioned embedded images; quotes/defaults stores optional absolute image coordinates in its A4 documentDesign. No DDL needed. Quote preferences: page_name='quotes', preference_key='defaults' stores one A4 documentDesign (ordered sections, text/fields, embedded PNG/JPEG images, table columns and typography), notes/terms, accepted-edit policy, approval/conversion invoice due days and retainCustomerNotes/retainTermsAndConditions conversion choices as versioned JSON. No new database fields are required. Optional professional layout, live item thumbnails, paired text columns, text headings and field sign-off/contact roles reuse the same section kinds and columns. Company branding/addresses and item photos are read live from owned existing records; they are not embedded in the saved design. No DDL.
